text: Binary per-row flag from the `argument` column, reading only the OP's own current text (including marked edits): 1 if it contains a personal anecdote or first-person experiential narrative, meaning the OP recounts a specific experience, event or situation they personally lived through or took part in (e.g. "when I worked at...", "my friend and I..."). 0 if the argument is assessable but has none: purely abstract claims, hypotheticals or invented scenarios, general statements, or experiences only of others or of quoted external sources that the OP does not adopt as their own. Bare first-person opinion phrases ("I think") do not count. Ignore view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed, even if they contain first-person narrative. Generic discussion of delta or platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered. Do not try to reconstruct an initial version of the post. Output null if the argument is missing or malformed.
